raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be on"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the Silver plan"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be"
  role subject "Biscuit"
  role object "a 9 year old beagle"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "have a dental with two extractions at"
  role subject "Biscuit"
  role object "Riverside Vets"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "quote"
  role subject "Riverside Vets"
  role object "£420"
  role recipient "the user"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "might go up"
  role subject "the price"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@q query
  where match
    relation "cover"
    role subject "PetGuard"
    role object "a vet bill over £300"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?p
  where match
    relation "cover"
    role subject "PetGuard"
    role object "the vet bill"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "need to get pre-approved before the operation"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to claim after"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
